# Charlotta

## Overview

- **Age:** Fourteen years old  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Role:** Handmaid to Miss Lavendar Lewis  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Charlotta the Fourth  <sub>[v2 c21 P46](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0046), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>

## Appearance

She is a warm-hearted girl who wears large, bright blue ribbon bows in her hair, which she braids into crinkly plaits. Her smiles are notably wide and cheerful. She wears white, stiffly starched dresses on special occasions and has plump hands.

_Sources: [v2 c23 P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 c27 P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 c27 P45](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0045), [v2 c28 P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048), [v2 c30 P11](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0011), [v2 c30 P27](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0027)_

## Personality

Charlotta the Fourth is a faithful, hard-working, and fiercely loyal handmaid who adores her mistress. She is practical, literal-minded, and prone to worry about potential disasters, but she accepts Miss Lavendar's imaginative pretendings without judgment. Highly expressive and enthusiastic, she holds a deep, admiring affection for Anne Shirley and attempts to emulate her mannerisms.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c23 P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039), [v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 c28 P53](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0053), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055), [v2 c28 P56](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0056), [v2 c30 P14](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0014)_

## History

Leonora Bowman was hired by Miss Lavendar Lewis to live at Echo Lodge for board and clothes, serving as her handmaid. Because her three older sisters—Charlotta, Julietta, and Evelina—had previously served in the same position and looked remarkably alike, Miss Lavendar dubbed her 'Charlotta the Fourth.' She welcomed Anne Shirley and Diana Barry when they accidentally arrived at Echo Lodge for tea, delighting in demonstrating the local echoes. Over time, she grew deeply concerned about Miss Lavendar's failing spirits and health, confiding her worries to Anne during a berry-picking trip. When Stephen Irving returned to court Miss Lavendar, Charlotta anxious watched the courtship unfold alongside Anne. Following Miss Lavendar's wedding to Stephen Irving, Charlotta helped clean and pack up Echo Lodge, preparing to move to Boston in the autumn to continue living with the newlyweds.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049), [v2 c21 P71](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0071), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c27 P37](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0037), [v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 c27 P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044), [v2 c28 P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048), [v2 c28 P65](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0065), [v2 c28 P71](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0071), [v2 c29 P10](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0010), [v2 c30 P34](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0034), [v2 c30 P36](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0036)_

## Background by volume

- Real name is Leonora Bowman  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- Member of the Bowman family, following three older sisters who previously served Miss Lavendar  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055)</sub>
- Called 'Charlotta the Fourth' by Miss Lavendar to avoid confusion with her sisters  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- Has young brothers at home  <sub>[v2 c30 P36](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0036)</sub>
